latest.content:

Holland & Barrett (H&B) launches FORMI™ Weight loss Complex containing SlimBiome®
OptiBiotix Health plc (AIM: OPTI, OTCQB: OPTBF), a life sciences business developing products which reduce hunger and food cravings, enhance the gut microbiome, and sweet fibres as healthy sugar substitutes announces the launch of
a new weight management product containing its clinically validated SlimBiome® formulation under Holland & Barrett's ("H&B") new own-brand, FORMI™.
H&B has over 1,600 stores worldwide across 19 countries, including over 700 stores in the United Kingdom. In December 2025 OptiBiotix signed a new 3-year non-exclusive trademark licence agreement (TMLA) granting H&B rights to use SlimBiome® and LeanBiome® marks on new products containing OptiBiotix's patented mineral enriched dietary fibre and prebiotic ingredients. SlimBiome® has now been launched under a newly formed H&B's own-label brand, FORMI™, encompassing active nutrition, weight management, and healthy food products.
The new FORMI WEIGHT LOSS COMPLEX is available online and in H&B stores, sold as a satiety supporting weight loss complex in Raspberry flavoured powdered drink sachets. The product has on-pack health claims of supporting weight management, helping to control blood sugar, and supporting satiety.
The product is targeted at consumers seeking non-drug approaches to weight management, including those who are overweight, consumers who do not tolerate GLP-1 treatments, and consumers seeking nutritional support following GLP-1 treatment.
A changing weight management market
The rapid adoption of GLP-1-based medicines has fundamentally changed the weight management market and creating demand for complementary, non-drug approaches. Emerging evidence suggests that weight regain following discontinuation of GLP-1 treatment can be significant, highlighting the potential importance of longer-term approaches to maintaining weight loss. Research from the University of Oxford (BMJ, Jan 2026) has reported that people stopping weight-loss medication can regain weight more rapidly than those ending traditional diet-based programmes. Separately, research published by The Journal of Obesity (2023) highlighted high rates of discontinuation among people prescribed GLP-1 weight-loss medicines and the challenges associated with maintaining weight loss following treatment.
This changing market dynamic has contributed to the emergence of a rapidly growing category of products positioned to support consumers before, during or following GLP-1 treatment. The global GLP-1 support supplements market has been estimated at approximately $1.8 billion in 2025 and is forecast to reach $8.9 billion by 2034, representing a CAGR of approximately 18.5% (MarketIntelo, 2026).
The launch of FORMI™ Weight Loss Complex further strengthens OptiBiotix's relationship with H&B and follows H&B's May 2026 announcement of a weight management partnership with online pharmacy Phlo. The partnership provides H&B customers with access to Phlo's clinical weight management services, including GLP-1 anti-obesity medicines, alongside H&B's existing nutrition, wellness and weight management offering. The combination of clinical weight management services with nutritional and lifestyle products reflects the increasingly holistic approach being adopted within the weight management market.
Stephen O'Hara, CEO of OptiBiotix Health plc said:
"The introduction and rapid adoption of GLP-1 medicines has led to a fundamental shift in the weight management market and created a significant new opportunity for nutritional products that can complement pharmaceutical approaches.
"SlimBiome®, supported by clinical studies, authorised health claims in major territories and multiple international awards, is increasingly being recognised as a clinically validated, natural approach to appetite, hunger and satiety management. We believe this positions SlimBiome® well both as a non-drug option for consumers seeking support with weight management and as a potential nutritional solution for consumers seeking to maintain their weight following GLP-1 treatment.
"We are particularly pleased to see H&B incorporating SlimBiome® into its new FORMI™ own-brand range. This demonstrates the growing recognition of SlimBiome® by major weight management and health and wellness businesses. We are seeing increasing interest from progressive companies seeking to incorporate SlimBiome® into their own branded products, purchase finished products developed by OptiBiotix, or use SlimBiome® in flavoured or unflavoured sachets as a range extension.
"The launch of FORMI™ Weight Loss Complex represents an important further step in our relationship with H&B and provides an opportunity for SlimBiome® to participate in the expansion of H&B's own-brand weight management portfolio."

company_30s.what_they_do: Opti Biologics is a niche biotech that develops and commercialises skin‑care and weight‑management therapeutics. Its flagship platform, SweetBiotix, is a topical probiotic formulation aimed at improving skin barrier function, while WellBiome is a surgical‑outcome‑enhancing agent. The company also explores proprietary bio‑engineered peptides under the SkinBioTherapeutics umbrella.
company_30s.why_they_matter: Skin disorders affect 30 % of the global population and the market for advanced topical treatments is growing at 10 % annually. SweetBiotix targets a high‑margin niche that can be scaled quickly once regulatory clearance is obtained. The company’s pipeline also taps into the expanding weight‑management space, a sector worth billions and projected to rise with rising obesity rates.
company_30s.current_state: Opti is still early‑stage with no consistent revenue streams. It is burning cash to fund clinical studies and has recently sold a portion of its shares to shore up liquidity. The stock has plunged sharply, reflecting investor scepticism about its commercialization timeline.

rns_narrative: The company’s most recent filings focus on two fronts: 1) clinical milestones – SweetBiotix sampling and a surgical‑outcome trial for WellBiome – and 2) shareholder‑friendly moves – an AGM, a director share‑holding disclosure and a partial share disposal to improve cash flow.

These announcements paint a picture of a firm that is trying to prove product viability while keeping the balance sheet afloat. The investor presentation signals an attempt to attract new capital, and the AGM indicates board‑level engagement with shareholders.
Collectively, the narrative suggests Opti is at a crossroads: if the clinical data look promising, the company could pivot from a cash‑burning start‑up to a revenue‑generating entity.

crowd_tape.dominant_theme: Quiet but watchful – the community is largely silent, with a few cautious voices debating the company’s chances.
crowd_tape.bull_narrative: A handful of traders are bullish on SweetBiotix’s potential to capture a niche in the topical market, citing early sampling data and the possibility of a quick commercial roll‑out.
crowd_tape.bear_narrative: Bears point to the company’s lack of revenue, heavy dilution risk, and the uncertainty around the WellBiome trial, arguing that the stock is still a speculative play.
crowd_tape.sentiment_shift: The mood has remained flat; no new influx of chatter has shifted opinion, keeping the crowd in a holding pattern.

whats_happening_now.attention_check: Google Trends is flat – no public interest spike, which means a sudden positive announcement could catch the market by surprise.

near_term_catalysts: Positive results from the WellBiome surgical‑outcome trial, especially if the study reaches statistical significance and the company announces plans for a Phase‑III roll‑out.
Regulatory clearance or a strong recommendation for SweetBiotix, allowing the company to start commercial sales or to license the product to a larger partner.
A new investment or partnership announcement that would inject fresh capital and reduce the cash‑burn rate.
A significant volume spike coupled with a break above the recent support level, indicating that smart money may be re‑entering.
expect_next.watch_for: Key signals to monitor over the next 2–3 months: 1) the release of trial data or regulatory updates, 2) any sudden jump in trading volume (≥ 50 % above the 30‑day average), 3) a price move that clears the last major support zone, and 4) any mention of a strategic partnership in press releases.
expect_next.timing_regime: The stock appears to be in the early stages of a recovery cycle – the crash is deep, but the price is still near its all‑time low. AAPL‑style compression suggests that a breakout could be imminent if a catalyst materialises.

buy_vs_sell.bull_case: A deep 70‑95 % crash creates a dramatic mean‑reversion window. If the company delivers a positive clinical signal or regulatory nod, the price could rebound to roughly the midpoint of its 52‑week range, implying a 100 % upside from the current trough. Historically, such deep crashes have produced 160 %+ returns in the long run.
buy_vs_sell.bear_case: The main risk is that the company will fail to secure a commercial partner or that the clinical data will be inconclusive, leaving the firm stuck in a cash‑burn cycle. A worst‑case scenario is a further 10 % decline before the stock is delisted or forced to liquidate assets.
buy_vs_sell.risk_reward: Potential loss: 10 % of the entry price (a stop 10 % below). Potential gain: 100 % (price back to the 52‑week midpoint). The risk‑reward ratio is therefore roughly 1:10, a classic asymmetric play.

playbook.if_bullish: Enter when volume spikes and the price clears the last support level, placing a stop 10 % below the entry. Position size should be limited to 5 % of the portfolio to keep overall risk manageable.
playbook.if_watching: Hold cash until either a positive trial outcome is announced or a clear volume surge occurs. If the price remains flat and volume stays low, consider tightening the stop to 5 % to protect capital.
playbook.if_passing: None identified at present; the company has not shown any imminent delisting or bankruptcy signals.

ai_insights.bottom_line: Deep crash, potential catalyst from SweetBiotix commercialization, asymmetric upside – a contrarian bullish play if the company delivers a positive clinical signal.
